corruption_selection.rule: rank each transition by SHA256(successor_composition_digest|family_id|state|action); choose two lowest
corruption_selection.second_selected_corruption: REPLACE destination with lexicographically first existing output state != gold

repair_input: only externally returned failing obligations for corrupted pairs
claim_fence: A PASS would establish bounded cross-family transfer of the already-frozen repair machinery to two declarative policy carriers. It would not establish semantic mastery of abstention/security, hidden-benchmark performance, or general transfer.
